name: Tool ID
meaning: The tool.

name: Name
meaning: What the tool is.

name: Description
meaning: Anything a borrower should know.

name: Condition
meaning: Whether the tool is fit to lend.

name: Damage note
meaning: What is wrong, while the tool needs repair.

name: Added at
meaning: When the tool joined the catalog.

name: Status
meaning: What a borrower sees: `on_loan` while the tool has an active loan, else `needs_repair` when it needs repair (TL-LEND-SP04), else `available`.

name: Month
meaning: The month measured, as YYYY-MM.

name: Loans per tool
meaning: Loans opened in the month over the tools in the catalog at its end (TL-BO01).

name: Share of loans late
meaning: Of the loans due in the month, by their due date as renewed, the share returned late or still out and overdue (TL-BO02).

name: Median days to repair
meaning: Of the repairs made in the month, the median days from the tool's damage report to its repair, none when there was no repair (TL-BO05).

name: Active members
meaning: Members who opened a loan in the 90 days up to the month's end (TL-BO04).

name: Loan ID
meaning: The loan.

name: Member ID
meaning: Who borrowed the tool.

name: Tool ID
meaning: Which tool is out.

name: Borrowed at
meaning: When the loan started.

name: Due date
meaning: The last day of the loan, in the library's time zone (TL-LEND-INV04).

name: Tool ID
meaning: The tool.

name: Name
meaning: What the tool is.

name: Damage note
meaning: What is wrong with the tool.

name: Damage reported at
meaning: When the damage was reported: how long the tool has been waiting.

name: On loan
meaning: Whether the tool is still out on a loan, so not yet back for repair.
